test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of students studying in six schools. Total number of students studying in all these six schools are 9000.

Number of students studying in a particular school is shown as a percentage of total number of student studying in all these six schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c5b8f259d92c634d621f1672ebc764d22ad282595733a6c131e5cc05da4bf04.png] 

What is the difference between the number of students studying in school A and B together and school D and F together?
solution:
**Given**

The number of students studying in school A = 5%

The number of students studying in school B = 35%

The number of students studying in school d = 21%

The number of students studying in school F = 10%

**Calculation**

The number of students studying in schools A and B together = 35 + 5

⇒ 40%

The number of students studying in schools D and F together = 21 + 10

⇒ 31%

As we know,

⇒ 360° = 100%

⇒ 100% = 9000

⇒ 1% = 9000/100

⇒ 1% = 90 ......eq(i)

The difference between the number of students studying in schools A and B together and schools D and F together = 40 - 31

⇒ 9%

⇒ 9% = 9 × 90

**Difference = 810.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__** The total of all data in a pie is equal to 360° and the total value of a pie is always 100%.
